text: --- title: "Lumen Bakery handbook" description: Everything a new baker needs: the oven, the rota and the till. sidebar_label: Handbook weight: 4 draft: false --- import { Callout, Kbd } from '@/components/ui' import Rota from './rota.mdx' export const meta = { owner: 'Ada', updated: 2026, } # Welcome to {meta.owner}'s bakery Before your first shift, read this page once and keep it open. It covers the **oven**, the _rota_ and the `till`. Questions? Ask in the staff channel or email . ## The oven Press Ctrl + Shift + P to open the oven panel, then pick a program. Never open the door while the fan is running. Wait for the beep. 1. Preheat to 230 degrees. 2. Load the trays (at most {meta.updated - 2020} per rack). 3. Start the timer and note the batch number. - Sourdough: 35 minutes - Rye: 45 minutes, [see the recipe](https://example.org/recipes/rye_bread) - A literal \{ brace and a literal \< bracket stay escaped. ## The rota | Day | Early | Late | |-----|-------|------| | Mon | Ana | Ben | | Tue | Ben \| Cy | Ana | {/* internal: check the rota against payroll before publishing */} > Swap shifts at least two days ahead. The manager must confirm by message. ## The till ![Till screen](/img/till.png) ![](/img/empty-alt.png) The POS accepts cash and cards. For refunds see [the policy][refunds].[^1] [refunds]: https://example.org/refunds "Refund policy" [^1]: Refunds above 50 need a manager. ```bash $ ./close-till.sh --today ``` --- Thank you for reading, and welcome to the team!
